subject: Request: Q1 security hires + proposed compensation framework
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Q1 security hires + proposed compensation framework

Team —

I'm requesting approval to open two headcount slots for Q1 FY27 in Security/Compliance:

1) Senior GRC Manager (IC, 1.0 FTE) — lead vendor risk, SOC2 roadmap, and policy automation.
2) Security Engineering (Incident Response specialist, Senior IC, 1.0 FTE) — focus on detection engineering and playbook automation.

Rationale (short):
- We have three enterprise customers in contract negotiation who have asked for stronger GRC coverage and independent evidence timelines.
- Our on-call and incident playbook backlog is growing; we need a senior engineer to reduce MTTR and take ownership of detection/response automation.
- Both hires are strategic to unlock Dedicated and Private deals where security SLAs are gating.

Comp bands & budget: attached are the proposed compensation bands (sec_hiring_comp_bands_v3.pdf) and a headcount impact model (hc_impact_model_Q1FY27.xlsx). High-level ask: combined OTE budget envelope of $360k (base + on-target comp + hiring overhead) for both roles for FY27 run-rate.

Timing: Recruit kick-off in early December, target offers late Jan, start dates early March (standard notice window).

Approvals requested:
- Laura: budget sign-off and headcount authorization to post (will route to People Ops once approved).
- Mina: confirmation of comp bands against current market and any negotiation guardrails.
- Marissa: confirmation these roles map to product/pricing priorities and revenue pull-through assumptions.

Please reply with any concerns or OKs. If helpful, I can set up a 20-min sync with People Ops and Recruiting.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sec_hiring_comp_bands_v3.pdf (summary of bands and benchmarking), hc_impact_model_Q1FY27.xlsx (cost/run-rate scenarios)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Q1 security hires + proposed compensation framework

Thanks Markus — quick read-through and a few questions before I can sign off: 

1) Can you confirm the specific comp bands in the attachment are total cash (base + target bonus) or OTE (including any sign-on)? The PDF shows band ranges but the label is ambiguous.
2) Which budget owner will absorb the FY27 run-rate if both roles start in March? Is this within Security central budget or do we allocate across Product/Platform?
3) For the Senior GRC role, do we have an internal candidate in the pipeline or is this a straight external search? If internal, headcount timing may shift.

If you can reply with those clarifications I'll either approve or request a quick exec call. Appreciate the tight rationale — important hires.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief People Officer (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Q1 security hires + proposed compensation framework

Laura —

Quick answers and context to help speed this along:

- Comp band labeling: Markus, the PDF's top-level columns are Total Cash (base + expected bonus). I recommend we treat the upper quartile as the negotiation cap for senior external hires; sign-ons should be exceptional and pre-approved by Finance.
- Budget owner: Security central (my org) will carry the base run-rate for FY27. Product/Platform will incur project-specific implementation work and may cost-share for FY28 adoption (we'll document via a chargeback).
- Internal pipeline: we've got one mid-level GRC analyst who could be promoted into the Senior GRC role but would require a backfill at junior level (adds complexity to timing). For go-to-market gating customers I'd prefer an external hire to reduce ramp time.

Operational ask: If Laura approves the base budget, I'll open the HC ticket with People Ops and give Recruiting the spec (I already vetted two preferred agencies; Jordan Adler at AcmeRecruit is ready to run the search).

I also ran the headcount model with a conservative revenue uplift assumption — attaching the model shows breakeven in <9 months for Dedicated deals we expect to land.

+1 from me for posting now, subject to Laura confirming the comp labeling and sign-on policy.

-Marissa
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: Q1 security hires + proposed compensation framework

All —

Thanks for the clarifications. I reviewed the attachments and the headcount impact model. I'm approving the request to post both roles with the following guardrails: 

1) Compensation: use the Total Cash columns in sec_hiring_comp_bands_v3.pdf as the baseline; sign-on offers capped at 10% of first-year total cash unless pre-approved by Finance.
2) Budget: Security central (Markus/Marissa) will own the FY27 run-rate. Any cross-org cost sharing for Product/Platform will be negotiated and documented before close of Q2.
3) Internal candidate consideration: if you promote internally into Senior GRC, submit the backfill justification as a separate HC change request.

Markus — please open HC-1129 in People Ops and copy me. Marissa — you can kick the agency and internal posting process immediately. Recruiting should use AcmeRecruit (Jordan Adler) as the preferred vendor for initial outreach.

Once the roles are posted, please confirm estimated interview loop and expected negotiation levers (relocation, sign-on) so People Ops can prepare offer templates.

Approved.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief People Officer (interim)
Redwood Inference
